name: berry_bush
description: Low autumn tundra berry shrub (blueberry/crowberry): thin woody red-brown stems branching from the base, separate clumps of small pointed leaves in red, orange and amber (gaps between them so it reads as a plant, not a mound), clusters of big bright blue berries with white bloom highlights. Not green, not a brown heap. Bottom-centre anchor, ~300x160 (x -150..150, y -156..0).
